text: Most climate scientists think global warming is happening.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: Yale/GMU Climate Change in the American Mind, Spring 2026
room.questionWording: Which comes closest to your own view? Most scientists think global warming is happening / there is a lot of disagreement among scientists / most scientists think global warming is not happening / don’t know enough to say
room.note: 25% said there is a lot of disagreement among scientists, 2% said most scientists think it is not happening, 19% didn’t know enough to say.

truthSource.label: NASA, Scientific consensus on climate change
truthSource.oneLine: Multiple independent studies find that 97% or more of publishing climate scientists agree the climate is warming.
